title: Spacious townhome, sleeps 8 — Hart Suites #8
description:
Nashville is calling and this is your base camp. Just 10 minutes from Broadway's honky-tonks, Belmont University, and Vanderbilt University, this stylish 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome sleeps 8 — perfect for bachelorette weekends, family trips & group getaways. Full kitchen, washer/dryer, fast WiFi, smart TVs, and FREE on-site parking. Your Music City basecamp awaits!

The space
THE SPACE

This isn't your average rental. A record player, guitar, and locally inspired artwork give this townhome real Nashville soul  the kind of place that feels like the trip the moment you walk in.

Sleeps 8 comfortably: 3 spacious bedrooms, 4 beds, 2.5 bathrooms. Everyone gets a real bed  no fighting over the couch after a night on Broadway.

Full kitchen: Cook group breakfasts before a day downtown. Drip coffee maker included for slow mornings.

In-unit washer and dryer: Pack light, stay longer, leave with clean clothes.

Fast WiFi and smart TV: Stream your shows, share your reels, or squeeze in a remote workday.

Free on-site parking: Multiple spots in the complex lot plus street parking bring the whole convoy without paying downtown garage prices.

THE LOCATION 10 MINUTES TO EVERYTHING

Broadway honky-tonks and live music. Bridgestone Arena and Ryman Auditorium. Country Music Hall of Fame. Hattie B's Hot Chicken and Five Points Pizza. Centennial Park and Radnor Lake hiking. Quick drive to BNA Airport.

Close enough to be in the action in minutes far enough to actually sleep.

WHY GUESTS BOOK WITH US

Hosted by Nashville Nooks, a local boutique team dedicated to exceptional stays. Fast communication we typically respond within the hour. Professionally cleaned before every arrival, with self check-in via secure smart lock for a smooth start to your trip. From restaurant recommendations to questions during your stay, we're always just a message away.

GOOD TO KNOW (PLEASE READ)

Self check-in after 4 PM via smart lock. No pets allowed service animals are welcome in accordance with Airbnb's accessibility policy. Lively side street means occasional road noise. Several similar units in this community; minor design details may vary from photos. Quiet hours after 9 PM great for groups, not for parties or events. Exterior security cameras for your safety (none inside).

Weekends near Broadway book fast lock in your dates now and start planning your Nashville trip.

Guest access
Guest access
Guest Access:You'll have the ENTIRE townhome to yourselves all 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, full kitchen, living spaces, and in-unit laundry. No shared spaces, no host on site, total privacy for your group.

SELF CHECK-IN: Self check-in: your digital door code is sent by text/email 3 hours before check-in  just enter it on the smart lock keypad. A backup lockbox with a spare key is also on-site for emergencies. Message us anytime if you need help.

PARKING: Free parking in the community lot (first-come, first-served) plus street parking nearby. Pull in, unload, and you're 10 minutes from Broadway.

FULL AMENITY ACCESS: Washer/dryer, kitchen, WiFi, smart TV, coffee maker everything in the home is yours to use from check-in to checkout.

24/7 SUPPORT: While we're not on site, the Nashville Nooks team is just a message away we typically respond within the hour if you need anything during your stay.
